architectureDecisions: D1 — AGENT_TOOL_RUN_HANDLE_V1 (export AGENT_TOOL_RUN_HANDLE_VERSION) = { version: AGENT_TOOL_RUN_HANDLE_V1, taskId, repositoryRoot, baseRevision, sourceHead, recoveryDir, worktreeRoot, candidateSha, coreSessionId, toolId, toolVersion, toolSessionRef, attemptIndex, maxAttempts, phase: ACT_COMPLETED|ATTEMPT_COMPLETED, status: RUNNING|ACCEPTED|EXHAUSTED|TOOL_UNAVAILABLE, feedback, createdAt, digest }. digest = sha256(canonicalJson(body without digest)) using the delivered canonicalJson from run-trace.js. Path: recoveryDir/handle.json. RecoveryError(code, message) with this.code, same shape as TraceError.

D2 — runSupervisedTask gains optional recoveryDir = null and onHandleWrite = null. Omitted recoveryDir: unchanged mkdtemp, UUID sessionId, no sessionStore, finally dispose. Set recoveryDir: if handle.json already exists throw RecoveryError HANDLE_CURRENT (no second semantic attempt); scratch = recoveryDir with worktree at recoveryDir/worktree, logs at recoveryDir/logs, createFileSessionStore at recoveryDir/core-session; sessionId = agent-task:${task.id} (stable); createHarness({ sessionStore, recoveryPolicy: { staleAfterMs: 0 }, eventSinks, tracer }) with the existing strategy/environment/verifiers/objective; first run uses createLocalGitWorkspace; worktree is NOT disposed on ACCEPTED/EXHAUSTED/throw; caller disposes via disposeRecoverableRun(handle). invocationObserver is forwarded unchanged.

D3 — resumeSupervisedTask(handle, { tool, env, invocationObserver, eventSinks, tracer, onHandleWrite, ...existing runSupervisedTask options except recoveryDir/task }) lives in supervisor.js, imports recovery.js (recovery.js does not import supervisor.js). It verifies digest and disk handle.json, then fail-closed checks of D5, reopens the worktree with reopenRecoverableWorkspace({ repositoryRoot, worktreeRoot }) (git rev-parse HEAD, no worktree add), createFileSessionStore on recoveryDir/core-session, createHarness as D2, harness.recover(sessionId, { force: true }) then harness.vary(sessionId) — never harness.start. createSupervisedAgentStrategy gains startAttempt, initialSessionRef, initialFeedback, skipFirstAct (all defaulting so existing callers are unchanged): phase ACT_COMPLETED resumes the same attemptIndex skipping ACT; phase ATTEMPT_COMPLETED starts at attemptIndex+1 with handle.feedback and handle.toolSessionRef. Codex uses resume.sessionRef; Kiro/agy resume by cwd. Same coreSessionId and worktreeRoot. Result is AGENT_SUPERVISED_RESULT_V1; attempts[] in this invocation keep their original index.

D4 — Core seam (research gap closed): createFileSessionStore({ directory }) in recovery.js implements load/save/supportsRevisions: true like createInMemorySessionStore, one JSON file per session id (including the AVO effect-journal id), atomic tmp+rename, StoreConflictError and normalizePersistentState from packages/core-harness/src/index.js. createResumableAgentRuntime is not used (runtime snapshots, no start/vary/resume). createJsonBackendSessionStore is the delivered proof that the port survives a new process but is not imported (Backend supportsDurableRecovery authority). Handle is written after the ACT capability returns (core.act has saved currentCandidate) and updated again after evaluate with feedback/phase ATTEMPT_COMPLETED; onHandleWrite(handle) is awaited after each persist; default null.

D5 — Fail closed with RecoveryError, no mkdtemp: MISSING_WORKTREE (path gone or not a git worktree of repositoryRoot); DIGEST_MISMATCH (body digest !== handle.digest); SOURCE_HEAD_DRIFT (git -C repositoryRoot rev-parse HEAD !== handle.sourceHead); STALE_HANDLE (disk handle.json digest !== provided handle.digest); HANDLE_CURRENT (runSupervisedTask when handle.json already exists); HANDLE_COMPLETE (resume when status is ACCEPTED, EXHAUSTED or TOOL_UNAVAILABLE); TOOL_MISMATCH (tool.id !== handle.toolId); HANDLE_INVALID. A current handle cannot start a second lineage.

D6 — Tests in packages/agent-tools/test/recovery.test.js use fake CLI FIX_AFTER_FEEDBACK via defineAgentTool + test/fixtures/fake-agent.mjs. Crash: spawn test/fixtures/crash-supervised.mjs which calls runSupervisedTask({ recoveryDir, onHandleWrite }) and process.exit(97) when attemptIndex and phase match; parent then calls resumeSupervisedTask and expects ACCEPTED, same taskId, same coreSessionId, same worktreeRoot, source repositorySnapshot unchanged. Default-path tests omit recoveryDir and onHandleWrite. Scope assertions import auditPaths from test/scope-audit.mjs against this plan; they do not edit scope-audit.mjs.

D7 — Evidence: executed BB-100 productization probe (sessionIdUsesRandomUUID, disposesWorktreeInFinally, noResumeWorktreeOption) and executed BB-101 recovery-probe-result.json conclusions (crashResumeSeamIsCreateHarnessSessionStore, createResumableAgentRuntimeIsNotTheSeam, interruptedVariationNeedsRecoverForce, startCannotMintASecondSession, worktreeMustBeReopenedNotAdded, invocationObserverIsDeliveredPassThrough, fakeFixAfterFeedbackExists).

D8 — Living docs: docs/living/system/agent-tools/recovery.md (handle fields, default disposal, crash resume, fail-closed codes, disposeRecoverableRun) and a short pointer in docs/living/system/agent-tools/state.md. Living docs must not contain Blackboard ids. Optional one-line pointer in packages/agent-tools/README.md.
